about.title: About TarkovDex
about.intro: TarkovDex is an unofficial information service that organizes scattered Escape from Tarkov data for faster searching and comparison. Its goal is to present the prices, quests, maps, and boss information players check repeatedly in one clear, dependable reference.
about.itemsBody: Search by item name and compare reference value, value per slot, recent price movement, sale route, and data age.
about.tasksBody: Search by quest name or filter by trader and map to find the mission and requirements you need without scanning the full list.
about.gunsmithBody: Review the required parts and target weapon stats for each Gunsmith task before assembling the build.
about.mapsBody: Review player counts, raid durations, boss lineups, and spawn chances for each map in either PvP or PvE mode.
about.newsBody: Read official Steam patch notes, events, and the latest posts from the official @tarkov Twitter account, with links to every source.
about.economyBody: Compare estimated input cost, output value, margin, ROI, and hourly margin by station; flea fees and fuel costs are clearly excluded by default.
about.combatBody: Ammo ballistics and class 1–6 penetration performance are shown without inventing unverified probabilities.
about.armorBody: Compare default-configuration class, soft armor, protected areas, equipment penalties, and compatible ballistic plates.
about.dataBody: Game data and original news posts come from public external sources and refresh on a regular schedule. TarkovDex extracts the details needed for practical search and comparison instead of exposing raw datasets, and isolates temporary upstream failures so the rest of the site remains usable.
about.gameDataValue: Public static JSON API from json.tarkov.dev
about.newsDataValue: Official Escape from Tarkov Steam feed and @tarkov Twitter account
about.refreshValue: Game data cached for about 6 hours · news collected daily and marked stale after about 26 hours
about.supportValue: PvP and PvE · 한국어·简体中文·English
about.principlesBody: TarkovDex prioritizes readable information architecture, consistent search behavior, and clear sourcing over decorative excess. The same information stays in familiar locations when switching game modes or languages.
about.disclaimerBody: TarkovDex is not affiliated with or endorsed by Battlestate Games. Names, images, and game assets related to Escape from Tarkov belong to their respective rights holders. External data may differ from the live game following updates or changes at the source.

status.title: Data reliability
status.description: Where each dataset comes from, whether it is available right now, and when the value on screen was confirmed.
status.instanceNotice: These observations describe the server instance that handled this response. They are not a service-wide record of the last successful check.

delivery.staleCache: Previous cache used for this response

cachePolicy.price: Price documents are held in server memory for 15 minutes.
cachePolicy.structural: Structural documents are held in server memory for 6 hours.
cachePolicy.artifact: Finished builds are read from a file shipped with the site.
cachePolicy.live: Collected posts are stored in a database and the page is rebuilt every 10 minutes.

fallback.priceStale: If a fetch fails, the previous value is served for up to 2 hours and the page says so.
fallback.structuralStale: If a fetch fails, the previous value is served for up to 24 hours and the page says so.
fallback.artifact: Shipped with the deployment, so an upstream failure cannot affect it.
fallback.live: If collection fails, stored content still renders alongside the last confirmed check time.

impact.ok: You can use these values as they are.
impact.partial: Some records are missing, so the list may be incomplete.
impact.delayed: The values have aged a little. Confirm in game if the decision is close.
impact.stale: These values are old and may differ from what you see in game.
impact.previous: You are seeing the last values that were confirmed, which may no longer be current.
impact.unavailable: This data cannot be shown right now. Please try again shortly.
impact.unknownAge: There is no way to tell when these values were updated, so do not rely on their timing.

status.noObservation: No record on the server instance that answered
status.noSourceTimestamp: The source provides no update time
status.previousNotice: Showing data from the last confirmed check.
status.partialNotice: Some data could not be fetched, so the list may be incomplete.
status.staleNotice: The data on screen is older than the threshold for this domain.
